v2.3: RIS/EndNote export, core-journal tagging, batch tasks. v2.2: dual-source verification (Weipu+yiigle CMA), ISSN/CN completion, pending-downloads workflow. v2.1: yiigle source for CMA journals and official guidelines. Display name fixed.
v2.0.0: Chinese medical OA literature retrieval + PDF download + 5-state citation verification (Weipu OA, free, no login); relevance gate; SQLite cache; rate limits; pure stdlib
